protocol.declaration_record: This file is committed in Milestone 1, before any test-set scoring exists in git history. No width, level, or arm choice may derive from official-test rows.
protocol.dev_residual_definition: interval = pred +/- q, q = empirical |y_dev - pred_dev| quantile at the nominal level (linear interpolation, no finite-sample correction), over ALL eligible development rows.
protocol.fixed_width_rationale: mass grid mirrors the locked scorer's absolute tolerance bands (25/50/100 g, FROZEN_CONFIG scoring.mass_abs_tols_g); energy grid brackets the committed development aggregate MAEs across arms (dev_metrics.csv: 90.3-167.4 kcal) - development-informed, test-free.
protocol.grouped_split_conformal_definition: dev plate clusters split by seed into calibration/holdout halves (grouped: no plate spans both); cluster score = mean |residual| within cluster; half-width = conformal_quantile(cluster scores, level) with finite-sample correction ceil((n+1)*level) counting clusters.
protocol.nominal_levels_rationale: 50/80/90% - the p50/p90 error-quantile flavor of the locked scorer plus an intermediate 80%; coverage promises a UI would plausibly make.
protocol.population_discipline: official-test predictions are consumed read-only for scoring only; calibration uses development rows only.
protocol.unavailable_arm_policy: methods requiring per-record development predictions that are not committed get an explicit unavailable entry with a machine-readable reason; the study does NOT re-fit or re-acquire PR41's models.
